cohort: 61 women with recurrent implantation failure (RIF) and isthmocele who presented to an IVF Unit between January 2018 and December 2020.
finding: Hysteroscopic isthmoplasty significantly improves live birth rates (25.8% vs 3.3%) and overall pregnancy outcomes for women with recurrent implantation failure (RIF) and isthmocele undergoing IVF.
